top_signals.title: Hong Kong Resurrects China Bond Futures With Liquidity in Focus
top_signals.summary: It may be third time lucky when Hong Kong launches Chinese government bond futures on Monday, as Beijing pushes to offer a hedging tool key to the globalization of its debt market and currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: SK Hynix shares surge 25%, while Samsung soars over 20% as AI rally roars back
top_signals.summary: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
